translations.idiomatic: The Minister assisted the emperor in deliberating major state affairs and carried out orders issued from court.

sentences.zh: 其屬有六曹，凡庶務皆會而決之。

translations.literal: Subordinate to him were the Six Ministries; all routine business was convened and decided jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Ministries reported to him; routine business was convened and decided collectively.

sentences.zh: 凡官府之紀綱程式，無不總焉。

translations.literal: No regulation or procedure of any agency lay outside his general oversight.
translations.idiomatic: Every agency regulation and procedure fell under his general oversight.

sentences.zh: 大事三省通議，則同執政官合班；

translations.literal: For major matters deliberated jointly by the Three Departments, he joined the chief ministers in a single court formation;
translations.idiomatic: On major matters jointly deliberated by the Three Departments, he joined the chief ministers in a single court formation;

sentences.zh: 小事尚書省獨議，則同僕射、丞分班論奏。

translations.literal: for minor matters decided by the Department of State Affairs alone, he joined the Vice Directors and Vice Commissioners in separate formations to discuss and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: on minor matters decided within the Department of State Affairs alone, he joined the Vice Directors and Vice Commissioners in separate formations to debate and memorialize.

sentences.zh: 若事由中書、門下而有失當應奏者，亦如之。

translations.literal: If a matter originated in the Secretariat or Chancellery and was improper and should be memorialized, the same procedure applied.
translations.idiomatic: Matters originating in the Secretariat or Chancellery that were improper and required memorialization followed the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 與三師、三公、侍中中書令俱以冊拜。

translations.literal: Together with the Three Masters, Three Dukes, Chief Minister, and Secretariat Director he received appointment by written patent.
translations.idiomatic: Like the Three Masters, Three Dukes, Chief Minister, and Secretariat Director, he was appointed by written patent.

sentences.zh: 自建降以來不除，惟親王元佐元儼以使相兼領，不與政事。

translations.literal: Since the founding of the dynasty the post had not been filled; only Princes Yuanzuo and Yuanyan held it concurrently as commissioners with ceremonial rank, without participating in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Since the dynasty's founding the post had gone unfilled; only Princes Yuanzuo and Yuanyan held it concurrently as commissioners of ceremonial rank, without entering governance.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，詔：“尚書令，太宗皇帝曾任，今宰相之官已多，不須置。”

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe an edict stated: "The Minister of State Affairs was once held by Emperor Taizong; chief-ministerial posts are now numerous enough, and the office need not be established."
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 2 an edict declared: "Emperor Taizong once held the Ministry of State Affairs; ministerial posts are now plentiful enough that the office need not be established."

sentences.zh: 然是時說者以謂為令者唐太宗也，熙陵未嘗任此，蓋時相蔡京不學之過。

translations.literal: Yet commentators of the time held that the one who had been Minister was Emperor Taizong, and that Emperor Shenzong had never held the post — a lapse attributable to the chief minister Cai Jing's want of learning.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators of the day noted that the former Minister had been Emperor Taizong, not Emperor Shenzong — an error born of Chief Minister Cai Jing's deficient scholarship.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年，詔復置令，亦虛設其名，無有除者。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuanhe an edict restored the office, but it remained a nominal title with no appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 7 an edict restored the office, yet it remained a nominal title and no one was appointed.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，並省不置。

translations.literal: After the court moved south the post was not established in the consolidated departments.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south the consolidated departments did not maintain the post.

sentences.zh: 左僕射 右僕射掌佐天子議大政，貳令之職，與三省長官皆為宰相之任。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director and Right Vice Director assisted the Son of Heaven in deliberating great affairs of state, serving as deputies to the Minister; together with the heads of the Three Departments they bore the duties of chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Vice Directors assisted the emperor in deliberating major state affairs as deputies to the Minister; together with the heads of the Three Departments they shared chief-ministerial duties.

sentences.zh: 大祭祀則掌百官之誓戒，視滌濯告潔，贊玉幣爵玷之事。

translations.literal: At great sacrifices they administered the oath of all officials, inspected washing and announcement of purity, and assisted with jade, silks, goblets, and libation mats.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices they administered officials' oaths, inspected washing and purity announcements, and assisted with jade, silks, goblets, and libation mats.

sentences.zh: 自官制行，不置侍中、中書令，以左僕射兼門下侍郎，右僕射兼中書侍郎，行侍中、中書令職事。

translations.literal: Once the new offices took effect the posts of Chief Minister and Secretariat Director were not established; the Left Vice Director concurrently served as Vice Chief of the Chancellery and the Right Vice Director as Vice Chief of the Secretariat, performing those duties.
translations.idiomatic: Under the office reform the Chief Minister and Secretariat Director were not established; the Left Vice Director concurrently served as Vice Chief of the Chancellery and the Right Vice Director as Vice Chief of the Secretariat, performing those functions.

sentences.zh: 政和中，詔曰：“昔我神考，訓迪厥官，有司不能奉承，仰惟前代以僕臣之賤，充宰相之任，可改左僕射為太宰，右僕射為少宰。”

translations.literal: In the Zhenghe era an edict stated: "In former days my divine father instructed and guided the officials, yet the agencies failed to carry out his intent; looking to earlier ages, men of servile station were made to fill chief-ministerial posts — the Left Vice Director may be renamed Grand Steward and the Right Vice Director Junior Steward."
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenghe era an edict declared: "My divine father once instructed the officials, yet the agencies failed to follow his intent; in earlier ages men of servile rank had been made chief ministers — let the Left Vice Director be renamed Grand Steward and the Right Vice Director Junior Steward."

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，詔依元豐舊制，復為左、右僕射。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang an edict restored the Yuanfeng old system, returning the titles to Left and Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingkang 1 an edict restored the Yuanfeng system and revived the titles Left and Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，置左、右丞相，省僕射不置。

translations.literal: After the court moved south Left and Right Chief Councillors were established, and the Vice Director posts were not maintained.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south Left and Right Chief Councillors were appointed and the Vice Director posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左丞 右丞掌參議大政，通治省事，以貳令、僕射之職。

translations.literal: Left Vice Commissioner and Right Vice Commissioner participated in deliberating great affairs of state, jointly managed departmental business, and served as deputies to the Minister and Vice Directors.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Vice Commissioners participated in major state deliberations, jointly managed departmental business, and served as deputies to the Minister and Vice Directors.

sentences.zh: 僕射輪日當筆，遇假故，則以丞權當筆知印。

translations.literal: The Vice Directors took turns holding the brush each day; on leave or absence the Vice Commissioners acted in their stead and held the seal.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Directors rotated daily responsibility for the brush; during leave or absence the Vice Commissioners acted in their stead and held the seal.

sentences.zh: 大祭祀酌獻，薦饌進熟，則受爵酒以授僕射。

translations.literal: At great sacrifices, at libation, offering of prepared foods, and presentation of the cooked offering, they received the goblet of wine and passed it to the Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices, during libation, offering of prepared foods, and presentation of the cooked offering, they received the wine goblet and passed it to the Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 舊班六曹尚書下，官制行，升其秩為執政。

translations.literal: Formerly they ranked below the Six Ministries' directors; once the new offices took effect their rank was raised to that of chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly they ranked below the Six Ministries' directors; under the office reform their rank was raised to chief-ministerial status.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年五月，詔左右僕射、丞合治省事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng an edict ordered the Left and Right Vice Directors and Vice Commissioners jointly to manage departmental business.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng an edict ordered the Left and Right Vice Directors and Vice Commissioners jointly to manage departmental business.

sentences.zh: 是月，御史言：“左、右丞蒲宗孟、王安禮於都堂下馬，違法犯分。”

translations.literal: That month the censor reported: "The Left and Right Vice Commissioners Pu Zongmeng and Wang Anli dismounted from their horses below the main hall, violating law and overstepping rank."
translations.idiomatic: That month a censor reported: "Left and Right Vice Commissioners Pu Zongmeng and Wang Anli dismounted below the main hall, violating statute and overstepping protocol."

sentences.zh: 安禮爭論帝前，神宗是之。

translations.literal: Wang Anli argued before the emperor, and Emperor Shenzong agreed with him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anli argued the point before the emperor, and Emperor Shenzong upheld him.

sentences.zh: 今左、右丞於都堂上下馬，自此始。

translations.literal: From this time the Left and Right Vice Commissioners mounted and dismounted at the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: From that point the Left and Right Vice Commissioners mounted and dismounted at the main hall itself.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，復置參知政事，省左、右丞不置。

translations.literal: After the court moved south Vice Grand Councillors were restored, and the Left and Right Vice Commissioner posts were not maintained.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south Vice Grand Councillors were restored and the Left and Right Vice Commissioner posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中 右司郎中 左司員外郎 右司員外郎各一人，掌受付六曹之事，而舉正文書之稽失，分治省事：左司治吏、戶、禮、奏鈔、班簿房，右司治兵、刑、工、案鈔房，而開拆、制敕、御史、元豐六年，都司置御史房，主行彈糾御史案察失職。

translations.literal: There were one Left Secretariat Director, one Right Secretariat Director, one Left Secretariat Vice Director, and one Right Secretariat Vice Director, managing receipt and dispatch of Six Ministries business, reporting delays and errors in documents, and dividing departmental affairs: the Left Secretariat handled the Personnel, Revenue, Rites, Memorial Copy, and Roster sections; the Right Secretariat handled the Military, Justice, Works, and Case Copy sections; the Opening, Edict, and Censor sections were jointly managed. In the sixth year of Yuanfeng the General Secretariat established a Censor Section to conduct impeachment and investigation of censorial dereliction.
translations.idiomatic: One director and one vice director served each of the Left and Right Secretariats, handling Six Ministries receipt and dispatch, reporting documentary delays and errors, and dividing departmental work: the Left Secretariat oversaw Personnel, Revenue, Rites, Memorial Copy, and Roster; the Right Secretariat oversaw Military, Justice, Works, and Case Copy; Opening, Edict, and Censor sections were jointly managed. In the sixth year of Yuanfeng the General Secretariat added a Censor Section to impeach and investigate censorial failures.

sentences.zh: 催驅、封椿 印房，則通治之，有稽滯，則以期限舉催。

translations.literal: The Urgency, Sealed Reserve, and Seal sections were jointly managed; where delay occurred, deadlines were set and urging reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Urgency, Sealed Reserve, and Seal sections were jointly overseen; delays were reported with deadlines for follow-up.

sentences.zh: 初，於都司置吏設案，而議者謂台郎宰掾不當自為官司。

translations.literal: At first clerks and desks were established in the General Secretariat, but critics held that secretariat directors and vice commissioners should not themselves constitute a separate agency.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and desks were first established in the General Secretariat, but critics argued that secretariat directors and vice commissioners should not constitute a separate agency of their own.

sentences.zh: 遂隨省房分治所領之事，惟置手分、書奏各四人，主行校定省吏都事以下功過及遷補之事。

translations.literal: Thereupon affairs were divided according to departmental sections; only four hand-copyists and four memorial clerks were retained to assess merit, fault, promotion, and replacement of departmental clerks from chief clerks downward.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs were then divided among departmental sections; only four hand-copyists and four memorial clerks remained to track merit, fault, promotion, and replacement of departmental clerks from chief clerks downward.

sentences.zh: 元豐七年，都司御史房置簿，以書御史、六曹官糾察之多寡當否為殿最，歲終取旨升黜。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanfeng the General Secretariat's Censor Section established a register recording the quantity and propriety of censorial investigations by censors and Six Ministries officials as the basis for ranking; at year's end imperial decision governed promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanfeng the General Secretariat's Censor Section kept a register of censorial investigations by censors and Six Ministries officials, graded by quantity and propriety; at year's end the throne decided promotions and demotions.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，詔都司以歲終點檢六曹稽違最多者，具郎官姓名上省取旨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng an edict ordered the General Secretariat at year's end to inspect the Six Ministries for the greatest number of delays and violations, list the directors' names, and submit them to the department for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng 1 an edict required the General Secretariat, at year's end, to identify the Six Ministries with the most delays and violations, list the responsible directors, and submit them for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔御史台察六曹稽緩違失者，送左司籍記。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict ordered the Censorate to investigate Six Ministries delays and violations and send records to the Left Secretariat for registration.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict ordered the Censorate to investigate Six Ministries delays and violations and forward records to the Left Secretariat for registration.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，左司員外郎王蕃奏：“都司以彌綸省闥為職，事無不預。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe Left Secretariat Vice Director Wang Fan memorialized: "The General Secretariat's duty is to assist in managing the inner court; no affair lies outside its scope.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 2 Left Secretariat Vice Director Wang Fan memorialized: "The General Secretariat exists to assist in managing the inner court; no affair lies outside its purview.

sentences.zh: 今宰、丞入省，諸房文字填委，次第呈覆，自朝至於日中，或昏暮僅絕，其勢不ＲＣ一一檢閱細故，而省吏徑稟宰、丞請筆，以草檢令承從官齋赴郎官廳落日押字。”

translations.literal: Now when chief ministers and vice commissioners enter the department, documents from every section pile up and are presented in sequence for review from morning until midday, or barely finished by dusk; they cannot one by one inspect minor details, while departmental clerks go directly to the chief ministers and vice commissioners to request the brush, drafting inspection orders for attendant officials to assemble at the directors' hall at sunset for signature."
translations.idiomatic: When chief ministers and vice commissioners enter the department, documents from every section pile up for sequential review from morning to midday, or barely clear by evening; they cannot inspect every minor item, while clerks go straight to the chief ministers and vice commissioners for the brush, drafting inspection orders for attendants to assemble at the directors' hall at sunset for signature."

sentences.zh: 謂“宜遵守元豐及崇寧舊法，諸房各具簽帖，先都事自點檢，次郎官押訖，赴宰、丞請筆行下。”

translations.literal: He urged that "the Yuanfeng and Chongning old regulations should be observed: each section should prepare its own endorsement slip; first the chief clerk should inspect, then the director should endorse, and only then should they seek the brush from the chief minister or vice commissioner for issuance."
translations.idiomatic: He urged adherence to Yuanfeng and Chongning precedent: "Each section should prepare its own endorsement slip; the chief clerk inspects first, the director endorses next, and only then should they seek the brush from the chief minister or vice commissioner for issuance."

sentences.zh: 於是詔曰：“先帝肇正三省，詔給舍、都司以贊省務。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict stated: "The former emperor first rectified the Three Departments and ordered drafting officials and the General Secretariat to assist in departmental business.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "The former emperor first reformed the Three Departments and charged drafting officials and the General Secretariat with assisting departmental business.

sentences.zh: 今都司浸以曠官，緣省吏強悍，敢肆侵侮。

translations.literal: Now the General Secretariat has gradually neglected its duties, because departmental clerks are overbearing and dare openly to encroach and insult.
translations.idiomatic: The General Secretariat has gradually neglected its duties because overbearing clerks dare openly to encroach and insult.

sentences.zh: 自今違法事，其左右司官、尚書具事舉劾。”

translations.literal: Henceforth for violations, the Left and Right Secretariat officials and the responsible ministry director shall jointly impeach.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth violations shall be jointly impeached by the Left and Right Secretariat officials and the responsible ministry director.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔減左、右司郎官兩員，置中書門下省檢正諸房公事二員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan an edict cut two Left and Right Secretariat director posts and established two rectification clerks for all sections of the Chancellery-Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 an edict cut two Left and Right Secretariat director posts and established two rectification clerks for all Chancellery-Secretariat sections.

sentences.zh: 至次年，檢正省罷，其左、右司郎官依舊四員。

translations.literal: The following year rectification of the department was abolished, and the Left and Right Secretariat directors returned to four posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: The next year departmental rectification was abolished and the Left and Right Secretariat directors reverted to four posts as before.

sentences.zh: 紹興三十二年，詔尚書省吏房、兵房，三省、樞密院機速房，尚書省刑房、戶房、工房，三省、樞密院看詳賞功房，尚書省禮房，令左、右司郎官四員從上分房書擬。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Shaoxing an edict ordered the Department of State Affairs Personnel and Military sections, the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs Expedited section, the Department of State Affairs Justice, Revenue, and Works sections, the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs Merit Review section, and the Department of State Affairs Rites section to be assigned for drafting among the four Left and Right Secretariat directors by section.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 32 an edict assigned drafting among the four Left and Right Secretariat directors by section: Department of State Affairs Personnel and Military; Three Departments and Military Bureau Expedited; Department of State Affairs Justice, Revenue, and Works; Three Departments and Military Bureau Merit Review; and Department of State Affairs Rites.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，詔左、右司郎官各差一員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing an edict assigned one post from each of the Left and Right Secretariat directors.
translations.idiomatic: In Longxing 1 an edict assigned one post from each of the Left and Right Secretariat directorates.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，詔榷貨務都茶場依建炎三年指揮，委都司官提領措置。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiandao an edict ordered the Monopoly Office and Imperial Tea Market to follow the Jianyan 3 directive and be placed under General Secretariat oversight.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 6 an edict placed the Monopoly Office and Imperial Tea Market under General Secretariat oversight per the Jianyan 3 directive.

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，復添置右司郎官二人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao two Right Secretariat director posts were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 7 two Right Secretariat director posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 榷貨務都茶場， 都司提領。

translations.literal: Monopoly Office and Imperial Tea Market — under General Secretariat oversight.
translations.idiomatic: The Monopoly Office and Imperial Tea Market fell under General Secretariat oversight.

sentences.zh: 提轄官一員， 京朝官充。

translations.literal: One supervisory official — filled by a capital official.
translations.idiomatic: One supervisory official, filled by a capital official.

sentences.zh: 監場官二員， 京選通差。

translations.literal: Two market supervisors — filled by capital and local examination appointees in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Two market supervisors, filled in rotation by capital and local examination appointees.

sentences.zh: 掌鹺、茗、香、礬鈔引之政令，以通商賈、佐國用。

translations.literal: They managed the regulations governing salt, tea, incense, and alum certificates to facilitate commerce and supplement state revenue.
translations.idiomatic: They administered regulations on salt, tea, incense, and alum certificates to facilitate trade and supplement state revenue.

sentences.zh: 舊制，置務以通榷易。

translations.literal: Under the old system offices were established to manage monopoly exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system offices were established to administer monopoly exchange.

sentences.zh: 建炎中興，又置都茶場，給賣茶引，隨行在所榷貨務置場雖分兩司，而提轄官、監官並通銜管乾。

translations.literal: At the Jianyan restoration an Imperial Tea Market was also established to issue tea certificates; although the market was set up separately from the mobile-court Monopoly Office, the supervisory and market officials held concurrent jurisdiction over both.
translations.idiomatic: At the Jianyan restoration an Imperial Tea Market was added to issue tea certificates; though separate from the mobile-court Monopoly Office, supervisory and market officials held concurrent jurisdiction over both.

sentences.zh: 外置建康、鎮江務場，並冠以行在為名，以都司提領，不系戶部經費。

translations.literal: Outside the capital offices and markets were also established at Jiankang and Zhenjiang, all prefixed with the mobile court's name and placed under General Secretariat oversight, not under Ministry of Revenue appropriations.
translations.idiomatic: Offices and markets were also established at Jiankang and Zhenjiang, prefixed with the mobile court's name, placed under General Secretariat oversight, and kept outside Ministry of Revenue appropriations.

sentences.zh: 建康、鎮江續分隸總領所。

translations.literal: Jiankang and Zhenjiang were later separately subordinated to the General Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang and Zhenjiang were later placed under separate General Superintendency jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 開禧初，以總領所侵用儲積錢，令徑隸提領所。

translations.literal: Early in Kaixi, because the General Superintendency had misappropriated stored funds, they were placed directly under the Oversight Office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaixi, after the General Superintendency misappropriated stored funds, the offices were placed directly under the Oversight Office.

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，提領所置乾辦官一員。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao the Oversight Office established one handling official.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 7 the Oversight Office added one handling official.

sentences.zh: 右提轄官與雜買務雜賣場、文思院、左藏東西庫提轄，並稱四轄。

translations.literal: The above supervisory official, together with supervisors of the Miscellaneous Purchase Office, Miscellaneous Sale Market, Imperial Craft Workshop, and Left Treasury East and West Storehouses, were collectively called the Four Superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: That supervisory post, together with supervisors of the Miscellaneous Purchase Office, Miscellaneous Sale Market, Imperial Craft Workshop, and Left Treasury East and West Storehouses, formed the Four Superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 外補則為州，內遷則為寺監丞、簿，亦有徑為雜臨司，或入三館。

translations.literal: On external appointment they became prefects; on internal transfer they became court or directorate vice commissioners or registrars; some went directly to miscellaneous supervisory posts, or entered the Three Institutes.
translations.idiomatic: Externally they were appointed prefects; internally they transferred to court or directorate vice commissions or registrars; some moved directly to miscellaneous supervisory posts or entered the Three Institutes.

sentences.zh: 乾道間，榷務王禋除市舶，左藏王揖除坑冶鑄錢司，淳熙間，熊克自文思除校書郎。

translations.literal: During the Qiandao era Wang Yin of the Monopoly Office was appointed maritime trade commissioner; Wang Yi of the Left Treasury was appointed to the Mining and Coinage Office; during the Chunxi era Xiong Ke moved from the Imperial Craft Workshop to collator.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qiandao era Monopoly Office Wang Yin became maritime trade commissioner; Left Treasury Wang Yi became mining and coinage commissioner; in the Chunxi era Imperial Craft Workshop Xiong Ke became collator.

sentences.zh: 紹熙以後，往往更遷六院官，或出為添倅 ，有先後輕重之異焉。

translations.literal: After Shaoxi many were transferred to posts in the Six Institutes, or sent out as supplemental vice prefects, with differences of precedence and weight.
translations.idiomatic: After Shaoxi many transferred to Six Institutes posts or went out as supplemental vice prefects, with varying precedence and standing.

sentences.zh: 左藏封樁庫， 都司提領。

translations.literal: Left Treasury Sealed Reserve Storehouse — under General Secretariat oversight.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Treasury Sealed Reserve Storehouse fell under General Secretariat oversight.

sentences.zh: 監官一員，監門官一員。

translations.literal: One storehouse supervisor and one gate supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The staff comprised one storehouse supervisor and one gate supervisor.

sentences.zh: 淳熙九年，以都司提領。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chunxi it was placed under General Secretariat oversight.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 9 it was placed under General Secretariat oversight.

sentences.zh: 初創，非奉親與軍須不支。

translations.literal: At its founding disbursements were limited to imperial kin support and military needs.
translations.idiomatic: At its founding disbursements were restricted to imperial kin support and military needs.

sentences.zh: 後或撥入內庫，或以供宮廷諸費，亦以備振恤之用。

translations.literal: Later funds were sometimes transferred to the inner treasury, or used for palace expenses, and also kept in reserve for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Later funds were sometimes transferred to the inner treasury or allocated to palace expenses, and also held in reserve for relief.

sentences.zh: 提舉修敕令自熙寧初，編修《三司令式》，命宰臣王安石提舉，是後，皆以宰執為之。

translations.literal: Directors for compiling and revising edicts and regulations: from the beginning of Xining, when compilation of the Three Departments Regulations was ordered, Chief Minister Wang Anshi was appointed director; thereafter chief ministers always held the post.
translations.idiomatic: Directors for compiling and revising edicts and regulations: from Xining, when compilation of the Three Departments Regulations began, Chief Minister Wang Anshi served as director; thereafter chief ministers always held the post.

sentences.zh: 詳定官，以侍從之通法令者充，舊制二員。

translations.literal: Determination officials were drawn from attendant officials versed in statutes; the old quota was two posts.
translations.idiomatic: Determination officials were drawn from attendant officials versed in law; the original quota was two posts.

sentences.zh: 宣和中，增至七員。

translations.literal: In the Xuanhe era the number was increased to seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuanhe era the quota rose to seven.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，減為三員。

translations.literal: Early in Jingkang it was reduced to three.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jingkang the quota was cut to three.

sentences.zh: 刪定官，無常員。

translations.literal: Revision officials had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Revision officials carried no fixed establishment.

sentences.zh: 先是，嘗別修一司敕命。

translations.literal: Previously a separate compilation of single-agency edicts and orders had been undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: A separate compilation of single-agency edicts and orders had previously been undertaken.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，詔六曹刪定官併入詳定一司敕令所，為一局。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daguan an edict merged the Six Ministries' revision officials into the Determination Office for Single-Agency Edicts and Regulations as one bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 3 an edict merged the Six Ministries' revision officials into the Determination Office for Single-Agency Edicts and Regulations as a single bureau.

sentences.zh: 制置三司條例司掌經畫邦計，議變舊法以通天下之利。

translations.literal: The Bureau for Managing the Three Departments Regulations managed state fiscal planning and deliberated changes to old laws to extend benefit throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau for Managing the Three Departments Regulations oversaw state fiscal planning and deliberated reforms to old laws to extend benefit throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年置，以知樞密院陳升之參知政事王安石為之，而蘇轍、程顥等亦皆為屬官。

translations.literal: Established in the second year of Xining, it was headed by Military Affairs Commissioner Chen Shengzhi and Vice Grand Councillor Wang Anshi, with Su Zhe, Cheng Hao, and others also serving as subordinate officials.
translations.idiomatic: Created in Xining 2, it was headed by Military Affairs Commissioner Chen Shengzhi and Vice Grand Councillor Wang Anshi, with Su Zhe, Cheng Hao, and others as subordinate officials.

sentences.zh: 未幾，升之相，乃言：“條例者有司事爾，非宰相之職，宜罷之。”

translations.literal: Before long, when Shengzhi became chancellor, he said: "Regulations are the business of the regular offices, not the duty of the chancellor; they should be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Soon after Shengzhi rose to the chancellorship, he argued that drafting regulations was work for the regular offices, not suited for the chief minister, and ought to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 帝欲並歸中書，安石請以樞密副使韓絳代升之焉。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to return it all to the Secretariat; An Shi requested that Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Han Jiang replace Shengzhi in the post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wanted the bureau folded back into the Secretariat; Wang Anshi proposed that Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Han Jiang take Shengzhi's place.

sentences.zh: 三年，判大名府韓琦言：“條例司雖大臣所領，然止是定奪之所。

translations.literal: In the third year, Han Qi, acting prefect of Daming Prefecture, said: "Although the Regulations Bureau is headed by a great minister, it is only a place for final decision."
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, Han Qi, administrator of Daming Prefecture, observed that although a senior minister headed the Regulations Bureau, it was merely a decision-drafting office.

sentences.zh: 今不關中書而徑自行下，則是中書之外又有一中書也。”

translations.literal: Now if it does not pass through the Secretariat but issues orders directly, then beyond the Secretariat there is another Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: If it issued orders on its own without routing through the Secretariat, there would effectively be a second Secretariat beside the first.

sentences.zh: 五月，罷歸中書。

translations.literal: In the fifth month it was abolished and returned to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That fifth month the bureau was abolished and its functions restored to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三司會計司 熙寧七年，置於中書，以宰相韓絳提舉。

translations.literal: Three Fiscal Commissions Accounting Office: in the seventh year of Xining it was established within the Secretariat, with Chancellor Han Jiang as supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Three Fiscal Commissions Accounting Office: established within the Secretariat in Xining 7 under Chancellor Han Jiang's supervision.

sentences.zh: 先是，絳言總天下財賦，而無考較盈虛之法，乃置是司。

translations.literal: Previously Jiang had said that although all revenue under heaven was consolidated, there was no method for comparing surplus and deficit, and so this office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jiang had earlier argued that although the empire's revenue was consolidated, there was no way to audit surplus and deficit—hence the office was created.

sentences.zh: 既而事多濡滯，八年，絳坐此罷相，局亦尋廢。

translations.literal: Before long business piled up in delays; in the eighth year Jiang was dismissed as chancellor on this account, and the bureau was soon abolished as well.
translations.idiomatic: Business soon bogged down in delays; in year 8 Jiang lost the chancellorship over the issue, and the bureau was abolished shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 編修條例司 熙寧初置，八年罷。

translations.literal: Regulations Compilation and Revision Office: established at the beginning of Xining, abolished in the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations Compilation and Revision Office: created early in the Xining era and abolished in year 8.

sentences.zh: 經撫房 專治邊事。

translations.literal: Frontier Pacification Section: it specialized in managing frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier Pacification Section: devoted exclusively to frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，宰臣王黼主伐燕之議，置於三省，不復以關樞密院。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuanhe, Chancellor Wang Fu advocated the campaign against Yan; it was placed in the Three Departments and no longer routed through the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 4: with Chancellor Wang Fu pushing the Yan campaign, the section was placed under the Three Departments and no longer coordinated with the Military Bureau.

sentences.zh: 六年，罷。

translations.literal: In the sixth year it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in year 6.

sentences.zh: 議禮局 大觀元年，詔於尚書省置，以執政兼領。

translations.literal: Rites Deliberation Bureau: in the first year of Daguan an edict ordered its establishment in the Department of State Affairs, to be concurrently headed by a chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Rites Deliberation Bureau: established in the Department of State Affairs by edict in Daguan 1, with a chief administrator serving concurrently as head.

sentences.zh: 詳議官二員，以兩制充。

translations.literal: Two detailed deliberation officials, filled by members of the two scriptura ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Two detailed deliberation officers, drawn from the two scriptura grades.

sentences.zh: 應凡禮制本末，皆議定取旨。

translations.literal: For all ritual systems from origin to end, deliberation was held and imperial approval obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Every aspect of ritual practice, from first principles to final form, was deliberated and submitted for imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，《五禮儀註》成，罷局。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, when the Annotated Five Rites was completed, the bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 3: once the "Annotated Five Rites" was completed, the bureau was dissolved.

sentences.zh: 禮制局 討論古今宮室、車服、器用、、冠昏、喪祭沿革制度。

translations.literal: Rites System Bureau: it deliberated on the evolving institutions of palaces and halls, carriages and vestments, implements and vessels, capping and marriage, mourning and sacrifice from antiquity to the present.
translations.idiomatic: Rites System Bureau: examined historical and contemporary institutions governing palaces, carriages and dress, implements, capping and marriage rites, and mourning and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，置於編類御筆所，有詳議、同詳議官，宣和二年，詔與大晟府製造所協聲律官並罷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe it was placed in the Imperial Brush Compilation Office, with Detailed Deliberation and Co-Deliberation officials; in the second year of Xuanhe an edict abolished it together with the Great Splendor Directorate's Manufacture Office and the Harmonizing Pitch and Law officials.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 2: housed within the Imperial Brush Compilation Office with detailed and co-deliberation officers; Xuanhe 2: an edict abolished it along with the Great Splendor Directorate's manufacture office and the officials who coordinated pitch and law.
